programme.title: Ski jumping: World Cup competition in Wisła
programme.desc: The Adam Małysz ski jump in Wisła is the third stop of this year's World Cup. After unpleasant views at the beginning of the season in Lillehammer, where only a handful of (mainly Polish) fans appeared in the stands, here we can count on the fans' loud support. The main actors should be the Austrians, who performed fantastically at the inauguration. Both the old guard and the young wolves showed phenomenal form. Last year's Crystal Ball winner, Stefan Kraft, was just off the podium twice in Lillehammer. The lowest step on the first day was taken by Maximilian Ortner... who was called up for this competition on an emergency basis and it was only his third appearance in the World Cup competition. If we add the excellent performances of Jan Hoerl and Daniel Tschofenig, we have clear favorites in the Nations Cup competition

programme.desc: We will look at the work of five coaches of PKO BP Ekstraklasa clubs during the 2024/25 season. Faced with challenges, coaches must make difficult decisions and motivate teams, balancing between their own ambitions and pressure from club authorities and fans... Poland. 2025. documentary series

programme.title: I was the king – Grzegorz Lato | S01E02
programme.desc: A series presenting the profiles of the best scorers in the history of the Premier League. This is a great opportunity to recall the successes of Włodzimierz Lubański, Grzegorz Lata, Kazimierz Kmiecik, Grzegorz Piechna and Tomasz Frankowski. We will get to know different football generations. In the 1960s, Włodzimierz Lubański (Górnik Zabrze) was the top scorer four times in a row. However, in the 1970s, Kazimierz Kmiecik (Wisła Kraków) and Grzegorz Lato (Stal Mielec) reigned supreme. In more modern times, Tomasz Frankowski won four titles in the colors of Wisła Kraków and Jagiellonia Białystok. There will also be the story of Grzegorz Piechna, the unexpected top scorer from Korona Kielce in 2006. Grzegorz Lato won the top scorer's crown twice in the colors of Stal Mielec in the then 1st league, in 1973 and 1975. He was also the top scorer in the 1974 World Cup. After finishing his football career, he became a coach and later the president of the Polish Football Association (2008-2012). Poland. 2022-2025. documentary series

programme.title: Primates – The Secret to Survival | E01
programme.desc: A documentary series devoted to our favorite primates, presenting species that are rarely shown on screen. Modern technology has enabled creators to capture their world from a unique perspective and in their natural environment, whether it is the treetops of a flood forest or the dense bushes shrouded in the darkness of a Sri Lankan night. Over the course of two years, the filmmakers undertook twenty-eight expeditions around the world, braving snowstorms in the Moroccan Atlas Mountains and wading through flooded jungles in remote corners of Sumatra and Brazil. They were among the first in history to immortalize the newly discovered Tapanuli orangutan species and were the first in years to attempt to film a white uakari. One team spent over two months in Equatorial Guinea, camping on a remote beach to record the most intimate scenes from the life of a mandrill, one of the least understood primates in the world. In Sri Lanka, thanks to low-light technology, the first color images of mysterious gray loris in the wild were captured at night. Captivating animal stories combine real family drama with cutting-edge science. A seemingly terrifying silver-backed mountain gorilla encountered on the volcanic slopes of the Congo turns out to be a gentle and caring father to its young. According to the latest research, it is caring fathers who achieve the greatest reproductive success. Viewers will also see South Africa's elusive pygmy galago, part of a recently discovered urban population, as it raids the local zoo at night. In Malaysia, they will learn about the world of treetops from the perspective of white-handed gibbons, shown on screen for the first time in history. The unique series is narrated by naturalist Chris Packham. Among the fog-covered slopes of volcanoes in the Congo Basin live some of the largest and most famous primates. Among them is a silver-backed mountain gorilla that uses a surprising strategy. He bases his domination and power on a bold show of force, thanks to which he maintains order in the family's life. However, when the offspring refuses to respect the father's authority, the dangerous tyrant reveals his gentler face. It turns out that this dangerous leader is more than just an aggressive guardian of the hearth. He can also be gentle and sensitive. Recent research shows that an alpha male must demonstrate more than just strength to be successful. Meanwhile, hard times have come for the herd of bearded capuchin monkeys living in the Brazilian highlands. The sun-baked canyons there haven't seen a drop of rain in eight months. However, monkeys have found a solution to the lack of food and water - they catch lizards, which are a source of protein and water, and also eat wild cashew nuts, which are rich in fats and minerals. In South Africa, nocturnal galagos are also searching for missing food. In Pretoria, under the cover of darkness, they raid the city zoo. While the park's predatory inhabitants sit in cages, the galagos can roam around without fear. Clever animals have learned to navigate zoos with an unusual trick to help them do so - they smear sticky drops of urine on their hands and feet to leave a trail of scent behind them and at the same time give their limbs extra traction for jumping. In India's Western Ghats, lion macaques have abandoned cooperation in favor of a strategy based on the exploitation of other animals. Giant squirrels have an excellent sense of smell adapted to recognize ripe jackfruit, so clever macaques allow them to use it to then steal the prey from the squirrels. Lemurs living in Madagascar constitute one fifth of all primates. This island is also the only place in the world where they can be found. Like many primates, lemurs are attacked by ticks and other parasites. However, we meet a group of blue-eyed lemurs that have developed a brilliant way of dealing with pests - self-medication. USA, Great Britain. 2020. documentary film

programme.title: Wild Mysteries of China – Mythical Mountains | E05

programme.title: David Attenborough and the sea fig
programme.desc: A 200-million-year-old ichthyosaur skeleton was discovered on the coast of Great Britain. These are the bones of a huge sea dragon, a predator that hunted in the oceans during the times of dinosaurs. Host Sir David Attenborough tries to discover the history of this ancient creature... Great Britain. 2018. documentary film

programme.title: David Attenborough: songs of life
programme.desc: Sir David Attenborough selects seven of the most extraordinary recordings from the natural world and explores what these sounds mean to specific animal species. Each song - from that of a lemur, through the song of a humpback whale or a lyrebird from the order of passerine birds - was recorded during the lifetime of a famous naturalist who recorded and analyzed these songs for decades. The oldest recording was made when Sir David was five years old, the latest just a few years before the documentary was created. Each has an amazing story behind it and shows how much we still don't know about the natural world. When Sir David Attenborough was born, the science of song was transformed under Charles Darwin's theory of sexual selection, which labeled singing dangerous because it revealed the singer's location to predators. The same song also gives males a great chance to be noticed by the female and thus to pass on their genes to the next generation of birds. So the males sing, and the females listen and choose the best singers because, according to them, they will be the best fathers. New scientific trends in bird song are challenging these long-held ideas. Scientists invited to the program show that in fact, in most species of songbirds, females create their own songs - and only now do they have a chance to be truly heard. However, there is a concern whether we will be able to learn all the songs of these extraordinary birds - the human loss is loud, and the planet Earth is falling silently, as the host of the program also warns. The production is a continuation of the documentary film nominated for the Grierson Award. Great Britain. 2022. documentary film

programme.title: d/s Lost Treasures of Egypt. Tomb Raiders
programme.desc: Along the western border of the Valley of the Kings lies one of the last remaining unexcavated burial sites. This season, American Egyptologist Don Ryan works tirelessly to conduct a forensic examination of the contents of Tomb 49, hoping to find treasures left behind by ancient robbers. His team makes an incredible discovery - a ring from one of the great Egyptian pharaohs - Ramses III, which is 3000 years old. This forced Don to change the course of his research and lifted the veil of secrecy over the amazing history of state-sanctioned burial plunder on an industrial basis. Not far from the Valley of the Kings, in the necropolis of Deir el Bahari, a team of Spanish archaeologists led by Antonio Morales is studying the ingenious ways in which ancient builders protected their creations from possible plunder. Not far from the tomb of the great ruler Ili, a team of archaeologists has excavated a burial chamber and is examining a rare find of 56 vessels containing embalming materials. What was left of the robbers and early explorers turned out to be one of the greatest treasures of modern times, as the discovery sheds light on the mysteries of the mummification ritual. The fight against tomb robbers continues today. In Cairo, Dr. Shabaan of the Ministry of Culture is working with the US Department of Homeland Security to investigate three ancient mummy fragments being offered for sale on the black market in New York. Will Dr. Shabaan be able to return these remains to their homeland of Egypt? Dir.: Gwyn Williams, Mat Stimpson, Andy Bailey. Cast: Julian Barratt, Alejandro Jimenez-Serrano, John Ward, Colleen Darnell, John Darnell, Maria Nilsson, Chris Nonton, Salima Ikram, Aliaa Ismail, Iwona Kozieradzka-Ogunmakin. Led by: Julian Barratt, Rick Robles. UK, 2019

programme.desc: The Socorro Volcanic Islands are a remote, uninhabited chain of islands 400 km south of Cabo San Lucas in the eastern Pacific. programme.title: Eagles – kings of the skies

programme.title: Dogs out of control
programme.desc: Tough task for Graeme: The Akitas Yumi and Yuna attack their fellow dogs and make every walk a torture for their owner Maria. Mixed breed Pippa, on the other hand, is so hungry that he sometimes bites when someone tampers with his bowl.

programme.title: Expedition Europa
programme.desc: The landscape appears pristine, and the Scottish Highlands (above) are actually one of the geologically oldest regions on the continent. This is where Colin Devey begins his journey through three billion (!) years of Earth's history. The stages include the German low mountain ranges, the Azores and the seven Manpupunjor rocks in the Urals.

programme.title: Expedition Europa
programme.desc: The peregrine falcon circles elegantly over the Elbe Sandstone Mountains (above). In terms of geological history, this natural landscape is still relatively young. The striking rock formations were formed by the Elbe, which worked its way through the sedimentary rocks deposited by a primeval ocean. The Alps, on the other hand, were formed through a different geological process. High peaks such as the Matterhorn and Zugspitze were folded as a result of the collision of the African and European tectonic plates. Colin Devey also visits Vesuvius in Italy. The ruins of Pompeii bear witness to the destructive forces that lie deep underground.

programme.title: Extremes of the deep sea – icy abysses
programme.desc: Medusas with ten-meter-long trains, “bloodless” ice fish, sea cucumbers on legs: alien creatures cavort in the deep sea off Antarctica and in the Mariana Trench. Researchers there are on the trail of the secrets of extreme life artists. Why do some creatures grow into giants? How do animals withstand the enormous water pressure at great depths? \n\nAt 8,178 meters below the surface, a Marianas disc swam in front of the film crew's lens - a world record for a vertebrate! And even the lowest point on earth (11,000 m) is alive.

programme.title: Canada: A Year in the Wilderness
programme.desc: Canadian autumn is a time of amazing transformation. While hundreds of polar bears wait on a frozen Hudson Bay to hunt seals, beavers prepare their dams for winter. (Station info).

programme.title: Canada: A Year in the Wilderness
programme.desc: Porcupines risk their lives every day searching for food in the brutal Canadian winter. Meanwhile, little owls have no choice but to catch their food in the snow. (Station info).

programme.title: Canada: A Year in the Wilderness
programme.desc: In Canada, spring usually takes a little longer. Much to the chagrin of a pair of beavers. The two rodents are only safe from predators when their pond is completely free of ice. (Station info).

programme.title: Canada: A Year in the Wilderness
programme.desc: From tiny mountain goats to young pikas, the Canadian summer is a time of learning for baby animals. Only with the right skills can the offspring get through the winter safely. (Station info).

programme.title: The Atlantic: A Year in the Wilderness
programme.desc: Winter on the Atlantic is characterized by violent storms and bitter conflicts. While dolphins and orcas fight for survival, gray seals use the cold season to start families. (Station info).

programme.title: The Atlantic: A Year in the Wilderness
programme.desc: With the beginning of spring, the Atlantic comes to life again. However, no resident has time to breathe deeply. In just a few months they have to find enough food and mate. (Station info).

programme.title: The Atlantic: A Year in the Wilderness
programme.desc: It's summer! The North Atlantic is finally reaching warm temperatures and food is plentiful. In short: the returned sharks and whales find perfect conditions for feeding. (Station info).

programme.title: The Atlantic: A Year in the Wilderness
programme.desc: Autumn is coming to the Atlantic. For many young animals, it is now time to explore the vast ocean on their own and make final preparations for the coming winter. (Station info).

programme.title: Galapagos
programme.desc: The Pacific archipelago, which belongs to Ecuador, with its isolated animal world, provided evidence for Darwin's theory of the origin of species. To this day, the diversity of the creatures that occur approximately 1000 km from the mainland is fascinating: ancient turtles, marine iguanas, gannets and even sharks that frolic between the approximately 130 volcanic islands. \n\nProducer Jochem van Rijs stimulates thought in two visually stunning parts: “You see how fragile the balance is in a small ecosystem.”

programme.title: Galapagos
programme.desc: Life in the rugged, volcanic landscape of the Galapagos Archipelago presents many challenges. What does the daily struggle of the animal islanders look like? (Station info).

programme.title: Sri Lanka – The Monsoon Island
programme.desc: Monsoon storms spread from the rainforests to the coast. The rain influences the habitats of animals and plants from the jungle to the sea. (Station info).

programme.title: Sri Lanka – The Monsoon Island
programme.desc: Deep waterholes, green forests and fertile lagoons meet in the south of Sri Lanka. 215 species of birds live here, some of which are harmless and others of which are the most dangerous on the island. (Station info).

programme.title: Lions: The Law of the Pack
programme.desc: The floodwaters are receding and hordes of prey are returning to the banks of the Chobe. Keeza escapes with her boy, Tom Tom and Caller fight against enemies. Einstein finds a companion. (Station info).

programme.title: Großkatzen 24/7
programme.desc: The flood brings prey and danger: wildlife filmmaker Gordon Buchanan accompanies a pride of lions on the hunt, while cameraman Brad Bestelink observes a leopard seeking protection for her cub. (Station info).

programme.title: Fletchers' Family Farm
programme.desc: Kelvin visits the livestock market with son Milo while Liz helps give birth to a lamb. The twins' birthday party is disrupted by pigs escaping and a runaway sheep. (Station info).

programme.title: Fletchers' Family Farm
programme.desc: The Fletchers are under pressure: the flock of sheep is being medically checked, a lamb is thriving and Kelvin is hunting cattle. The summer festival also ensures wonderful family moments. (Station info).

programme.title: Wild School – orphans in the animal kingdom
Life Below Zero – Surviving in Alaska
Life Below Zero – Surviving in Alaska
Snake Man – The snake catcher
programme.desc: A black mamba eats stray cats, a python fights for survival - including 26 eggs. And then there's a Green Mamba in the engine compartment. (Station info).

programme.title: Snake Man – The snake catcher
programme.desc: Three dangerous missions for Nick Evans: a gigantic herald snake, a black mamba in the treetops and a cobra in a residential building. (Station info).

programme.title: Mysterious Korea
programme.desc: The Korean border has separated two hostile states for almost 70 years. But between the mines and barbed wire, a surprisingly lively natural world has developed. (Station info).

programme.title: Game of Leopard Thrones – The Queen of the Leopards
programme.desc: Leopard Queen Kurhula is dead. Her eldest daughter Thandi immediately claims the area for herself. Only her two little brothers, Xongile and Hosana, can pose a threat to her now. (Station info).

programme.title: NGƯỜI LÀM VƯỜN CHUNG THỦY - THE CONSTANT GARDENER
programme.desc: Một nhà ngoại giao tan vỡ khi người vợ trẻ của anh bị sát hại một cách bí ẩn và dã man. Tìm hiểu sâu hơn, anh thấy mình vướng vào hàng loạt vụ che đậy.

programme.title: MA SIÊU QUẬY - BEETLEJUICE BEETLEJUICE

programme.title: THỢ SĂN: CUỘC CHIẾN MÙA ĐÔNG - THE HUNTSMAN: WINTER'S WAR

programme.title: HARRY POTTER VÀ HÒN ĐÁ PHÙ THỦY - HARRY POTTER AND THE SORCERER'S STONE
programme.desc: Harry Potter biết rằng anh ta là con trai mồ côi của hai pháp sư mạnh mẽ và sở hữu sức mạnh ma thuật.

programme.title: HARRY POTTER VÀ PHÒNG CHỨA BÍ MẬT - HARRY POTTER AND THE CHAMBER OF SECRETS

programme.title: LONDON GỌI VỀ - LONDON CALLING

programme.desc: Ba năm kể từ khi Jurassic World bị phá hủy và bỏ hoang, Owen và Claire gắn kết một chiến dịch giải cứu những con khủng long còn lại khỏi một vụ phun trào núi lửa cấp độ tuyệt chủng.

programme.title: HUYẾT CHIẾN - BURNING BLOOD

programme.title: CÚ MÁY ĂN TIỀN - COBWEB
programme.desc: Phim kể về những người làm phim với nhiều câu chuyện hậu trường ít được phơi bày trên màn ảnh. Đạo diễn Kim Jee Woon dùng thể loại hài đen nhằm châm biếm ngành công nghiệp làm phim của Hàn Quốc những năm 1970, mang đến bức chân dung ngớ ngẩn và thú vị về những người đứng trước và sau máy quay.

Xoay quanh một thảm họa toàn cầu sắp xảy ra vào năm 2012, khiến Trái Đất bị hủy diệt. Cốt truyện tập trung vào những nỗ lực của một nhóm người sống sót để tìm cách thoát khỏi thảm họa và tìm kiếm một nơi trú ẩn an toàn.

programme.title: ANH HÙNG BÀN PHÍM - TROLL FACTORY

Quyết tâm lật tẩy sự thật, anh điều tra Team Aleph – nhóm chuyên tung tin giả. programme.title: DỊCH VỤ TRAI THUÊ - THE WEDDING RINGER
programme.desc: Doug Harris đến sát ngày cưới vẫn không tìm được một người bạn để làm phù rể. Anh tìm đến Best Man Inc, công ty chuyên cung cấp những người bạn giả, do Jimmy Callahan làm CEO, cho những người có cùng vấn đề như Doug. Và câu chuyện lên kế hoạch cho đám cưới bắt đầu làm khán giả cười bò.

programme.title: NHIỆM VỤ BẤT KHẢ THI: SỤP ĐỔ - MISSION: IMPOSSIBLE - FALLOUT
programme.desc: Tổ chức IMF phải ngăn chặn nhóm khủng bố Apostles sử dụng ba lõi plutonium để tấn công hạt nhân toàn cầu. Ethan Hunt hợp tác với sát thủ CIA August Walker trong một cuộc đua nghẹt thở, chống lại thời gian để ngăn cản vụ nổ hạt nhân trên hai trực thăng. Phim mang đến một cốt truyện kịch tính, dồn dập, đẩy các pha hành động lên đến đỉnh điểm với một cuộc chạy đua chống lại thảm họa toàn cầu đầy căng thẳng.

programme.title: VÙNG HỦY DIỆT - ANNIHILATION
programme.desc: Phim xoay quanh một nhóm các nhà khoa học quân sự đi vào vùng ánh sáng bí ẩn có tên gọi The Shimmer, để tìm hiểu thực hư chuyện gì đã xảy ra với các nhóm thám hiểm được cử đi trước đó. Tại đây, họ tìm thấy các loài động vật, cây cỏ và cảnh quan vô cùng kỳ dị. Mọi chuyện càng lúc càng nguy hiểm khi họ bắt đầu đối mặt với các lực lượng ngoài hành tinh.

programme.title: QUÁ NHANH QUÁ NGUY HIỂM 10 - FAST X
programme.desc: Fast X xoay quanh Dominic Toretto và gia đình phải đối mặt với Dante Reyes, con trai của kẻ thù cũ. Dante, đầy thù hận, sử dụng mọi thủ đoạn thâm độc để trả thù cho cha mình, quyết tâm phá hủy gia đình Dom.

programme.title: VÕ LÂM QUÁI THÚ - KUNG FU MONSTER
programme.desc: Trong khi truy tìm quái thú, Phong Tứ Hải chạm trán nhóm hảo hán chuyên cướp bạc của quan chia cho dân nghèo. Thế nhưng, bạc chưa bị cướp bỗng không cánh mà bay khiến triều đình phong tỏa khắp nơi để truy bắt. Nhóm nghĩa hiệp phải đối đầu với những thế lực vô cùng nguy hiểm.

programme.title: HỘI ĐỌC SÁCH: CHƯƠNG KẾ TIẾP - BOOK CLUB: THE NEXT CHAPTER

Chuyến đi ban đầu dự định là để ăn mừng, nhưng lại biến thành một cuộc phiêu lưu đầy bất ngờ và hài hước, khi họ gặp phải nhiều tình huống dở khóc dở cười, từ việc bị đánh cắp hành lý đến những rắc rối tình cảm.

programme.desc: Thần đồng vật lý Stillman được sinh ra để tạo nên những điều vĩ đại. Anh chỉ bị lạc lối khi bất ngờ bị cô bạn gái Debbie đá. Nhưng Stillman không chịu từ bỏ. Anh đã bắt tay vào nghiên cứu, sáng tạo ra cỗ máy thời gian để níu kéo người yêu.

programme.title: NGỘ KHÔNG KỲ TRUYỆN - WU KONG

Không giống như hình ảnh Tôn Ngộ Không quen thuộc với sự ngây thơ và hài hước, phiên bản này mang đậm chất sử thi, bi tráng và có phần u ám hơn. Bộ phim khai thác sâu vào tâm lý và cuộc đấu tranh nội tâm của Ngộ Không, khi anh ta phải đối diện với số phận và những lựa chọn mang tính quyết định cho cuộc đời mình.

programme.title: TẠM BIỆT, LÝ KHẢ LẠC - SO LONG FOR LOVE
programme.desc: Lý Yên, người mất cha trong một tai nạn trượt tuyết khi đang học năm hai trung học, luôn oán giận mẹ vì đã từ bỏ việc điều trị cho cha cô. Chú chó nhỏ Ke Le, được Lý Yên nhận nuôi, đã lớn lên cùng cô. Ngày sinh nhật của Ke Le trùng với ngày giỗ của cha, nên Lý Yên coi nó như hiện thân của ông. Sau khi trải qua những mâu thuẫn, trưởng thành và mất mát, Lý Yên cuối cùng cũng hiểu được lựa chọn của mẹ và học cách nói lời tạm biệt với Ke Le.

programme.title: NGÔI NHÀ BƯƠM BƯỚM - BUTTERFLY HOUSE
programme.desc: Ngôi Nhà Bươm Bướm là bộ phim xoay quanh câu chuyện muốn-về-chung-một-nhà của Hoàng (Liên Bỉnh Phát) và Ngọc Mai (Hoàng Yến Chibi). Bằng khả năng thuyết phục lém lỉnh thêm phần lì lợm, Mai đã thuyết phục được bố mẹ từ Bắc vào Nam để gặp gỡ và bàn chuyện cưới hỏi với gia đình của Hoàng. Nhưng đời chẳng như mơ! Mọi rắc rối dở khóc dở cười đã xảy ra bởi lẽ cả hai gia đình không chỉ khác biệt nhau về mọi mặt, mà họ còn sở hữu một bí mật động trời mà nếu nó bị bật mí thì có nguy cơ trở thành bo
